faq_heading: Coworking in Islamabad: questions before your first visit
faq_text: If yours isn’t here, ask us on WhatsApp.
faq_1_q: How much does a coworking space cost in Islamabad at CoNinja?
faq_1_a__html: A coworking seat is PKR 14,000 a month. Team space is PKR 14,000 a seat for teams of 20 or more, and executive private offices start at PKR 55,000 a month.
faq_2_q: Is there a day pass for the coworking space?
faq_2_a: Yes. A day pass is PKR 1,000 per day.
faq_3_q: Can I try the coworking space for free?
faq_3_a: Yes. We give a free trial of 1 to 3 hours. After that, a day pass is PKR 1,000 per day.
faq_4_q: How much is a meeting room in Islamabad per hour?
faq_4_a: The meeting room at CoNinja in E-11/3 is PKR 3,000 per hour.
faq_5_q: Do you offer a virtual office in Islamabad?
faq_5_a__html: Yes. We offer a virtual office at Professional Arcade, E-11/3. Message us on WhatsApp for the price and what is included.
faq_6_a: Yes, from Monday to Friday. Saturday hours are 12 PM to 12:30 AM and Sunday hours are 12 PM to midnight.
faq_7_q: Is the coworking space open on Sunday?
faq_7_a: Yes. On Sunday we’re open from 12 PM to midnight.
faq_8_a: 1st Floor, Professional Arcade, MPCHS E-11/3, Islamabad 44000. On Google Maps, search “CoNinja Coworking” or use plus code PX3H+HX.
faq_9_q: Is there a coworking space near F-11, F-10 or G-11?
faq_9_a: Yes. CoNinja is in E-11/3, next to F-11 and close to F-10, G-11 and D-12, so it works as a shared office space for people living or working in those sectors.
faq_10_q: Do you have power backup and fast internet?
faq_10_a: Yes. The floor has high speed fiber internet and 24/7 UPS power backup, so load shedding doesn’t stop your work.
faq_12_q: Can a team of 20 or more rent space?
faq_12_a__html: Yes. Team space fits 35 to 40+ people at PKR 14,000 a seat, with all bills included.
faq_13_a__html: Team space at PKR 14,000 a seat includes all bills. For a seat or a private office, ask us on WhatsApp and we’ll confirm what’s covered.
faq_14_q: Can I work night shifts for clients abroad?
faq_14_a: Yes. We don’t close between Monday and Friday, so you can work US or UK hours from a proper desk.
faq_15_q: Can I see the space before I pay?
faq_15_a: Yes. Book a free tour, come by during opening hours and decide after you’ve seen it.
faq_16_q: How do I book a tour?
faq_16_a: Message 0327 5393390 on WhatsApp or use the form below. We handle bookings on WhatsApp only.
